scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @voc-radar/web && npm run build --workspace @voc-radar/worker
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @voc-radar/web && npm run test --workspace @voc-radar/worker
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:workflow
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @voc-radar/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @voc-radar/worker
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @voc-radar/web && npm run lint --workspace @voc-radar/worker && npm run verify:database && npm run verify:release-config
scripts.verify:workflow: node scripts/validate-workflow.js && node scripts/validate-cluster-contract.mjs && node --test scripts/cluster-contract.test.mjs
scripts.deploy:worker: npm run verify:deploy-env && npm run build:web && npm run deploy --workspace @voc-radar/worker
